entries.name: Parrot
entries.style: chibi cube pet, deliberately blocky (Kenney Cube Pets); stylized size: 0.5 m to the top of the crest, about a real scarlet macaw standing on a perch (0.4-0.5 m to the crown; 0.8-0.9 m long only with the tail hanging down, which the cube pet's short raised tail does not have), so it is a little over half the cube-pet panda (0.9 m) in the same ratio as the real animals and knee-high to a 1.7 m adult; rigid parts moved by node tracks, no skin; colour map flattened to flat colours

source.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
source.note: The plan's own source (wave-1 row 33). Same zip, pin and route as the panda and lion: ingested through Blender with Textures/colormap.png as an extra member; the colour map flattens to 24 colours (the 17 reds and orange-reds of body, head and crest -> feather, the violet of wings and tail -> wing, the yellows of feet and wing undersides -> gold, the slate beak and pupils -> beak, the white eye rings -> eye). The source has no fly clip (its wings flap only in idle and dance, with the feet on the ground); a film that needs flight should pose the body in the air and play dance. Ground: run is a hop that dips 8 mm on landing and clamps; walk is a bouncy hop that never sinks; eat tips forward to peck (sinkAllowed).
